svg.title: Three questions take three read paths
svg.desc: A booking confirmation routes to the authoritative writer and a matching commit receipt. A manager report may route to a separately selected read replica only while its measured lag meets the fictional one-minute bound; the writer copies changes to that replica asynchronously. A reusable service description may route to an authorized cache with a defined key and expiry. A Multi-AZ DB instance standby is for failover, not read traffic; a Multi-AZ DB cluster with readers is a different deployment type. Conceptual design only.

g.text: Choose by allowed age and evidence.
Fresh now: use the writer's commit.
A stale copy cannot confirm it.
Example: at most one minute old.
Use a reader; check lag and time.
Pause or review fallback if late.
Availability is not a read path
